name: @pipeworx/mcp-hibp

tools.name: check_password
tools.description: Check whether a password appears in known breach corpora. Uses k-anonymity: the password is SHA-1ed locally, only the first 5 hex chars leave the worker, and the response is filtered to match the rest. Returns pwned count (0 = not seen). The password itself is never transmitted.

password.description: Password to check (stays inside the worker)

tools.name: check_password_prefix
tools.description: Direct k-anonymity lookup: pass the first 5 hex chars of a SHA-1 password hash, get back all SHA-1 suffixes with their pwned counts. Use this if you're hashing client-side and only want to send the prefix.

tools.name: list_breaches
tools.description: List all publicly-known data breaches catalogued by HIBP. Optionally filter to a specific domain (e.g., "linkedin.com"). Returns name, title, breach date, added date, affected accounts, description, data classes exposed, and verification status.

domain.description: Restrict to a specific breached domain

tools.name: get_breach
tools.description: Fetch a single breach by name (the "Name" field from list_breaches, e.g., "Adobe", "LinkedIn"). Returns full breach metadata.

tools.name: list_data_classes
tools.description: Canonical list of HIBP "data class" tags (e.g., "Email addresses", "Passwords", "Geographic locations"). Useful for filtering breaches.

tools.name: check_account
tools.description: Look up breaches an email account has been seen in. REQUIRES a paid HIBP subscription key (pass _apiKey). Returns the set of breach names; combine with get_breach for details.

truncate.description: Return only breach names (default true). Set false for full breach objects (counts as 1 query).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-hibp forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the hibp pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
